learningObjectives: Differentiate supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning.
Identify the main components of a machine learning workflow.
Select suitable learning approaches for common problems.

activities.title: Map Machine Learning Types
activities.instruction: Explore the characteristics of each major machine learning approach.

content.concept: Supervised learning uses labeled examples, unsupervised learning discovers patterns without target labels, and reinforcement learning learns through interactions and rewards.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Learns from labeled examples to predict or classify new observations.
Finds patterns, groups, or structures in data without predefined target labels.
Learns actions through interaction with an environment using rewards or penalties.

activities.title: Choose the Learning Approach
activities.instruction: Identify the machine learning approach that fits each scenario.

content.concept: The presence of labels, the desired output, and the learning setting help determine which machine learning approach is appropriate.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Predict house prices from labeled examples → Supervised Learning
Group customers based on purchasing behavior → Unsupervised Learning
Teach an agent to maximize rewards in a game → Reinforcement Learning
Predict whether an email is spam using labeled emails → Supervised Learning
config.answer: Predict house prices from labeled examples → Supervised Learning

activities.title: Anatomy of a Machine Learning Model
activities.instruction: Explore the main components of a supervised machine learning setup.

content.concept: Features, targets, training data, algorithms, learned parameters, and predictions are core components of a supervised machine learning workflow.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Input variables used by the model.
The value or category the model learns to predict.
Examples used to learn the relationship between inputs and targets.
The method used to learn a mapping from inputs to outputs.
Values learned from training data during model fitting.
The output produced by the trained model for new input data.

activities.title: Build the ML Workflow
activities.instruction: Arrange the machine learning workflow from raw data to predictions.

content.concept: A machine learning workflow progresses through data preparation, model training, evaluation, and prediction on new data.
